name: Silk-TS-TW
title: Silk
description: A full-screen shader paints soft diagonal folds of grey-lilac silk that drift and bend without end. It turns an empty section into a textured, fabric-like backdrop.
use: A quiet, premium section wants a moving textile texture behind its content.
avoid: The palette is a single flat grey, and its constant movement can distract from dense copy.
a11y: A canvas backdrop with nothing to label; the endless motion ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The whole stage is filled with grey-lilac cloth that looks like folded silk, soft diagonal bands running corner to corner. Highlights form pale ribbons while deep creases fall into near-black shadow.
behaves: The folds slide slowly sideways, bright ribbons and shadows crossing one another. The motion never stops, so the fabric keeps a gentle breathing rhythm.
customise: Speed, scale, base colour, noise and rotation are props; the wave shape itself lives in the shader and needs source editing.
weight: heavy: A three.js canvas re-renders a shader plane every frame.
demo: Full-bleed grey-lilac silk at default speed, scale and rotation.
polishWhy: Convincing silk folds with smooth, slow motion; the grey palette is flat and bands can blur.
